record.field: # Informational calculation rule: monetary amount is 0.0 JOD so it does not alter basic pay result = 0.0
net_var = payslip.attendance_net_reconciled if (payslip and hasattr(payslip, 'attendance_net_reconciled')) else 0.0 result = net_var > 0.0
# Overtime is banked to Extra Hours, NOT paid on monthly cash salary (0.0 JOD) # HR can pay banked extra hours anytime via Salary Inputs result = 0.0
cash_hrs = payslip.undertime_cash_deduction_hours if (payslip and hasattr(payslip, 'undertime_cash_deduction_hours')) else 0.0 result = cash_hrs > 0.0
